description: List files of one package version. Forgejo returns the full file list with no paging; page (default 1) and limit (default 30, maximum 50) slice it client-side. Returns {files, page, limit, count, has_next, total_count}. total_count is the fetched list length (the files endpoint has no X-Total-Count). Each file is id, name, size, sha256.

type.description: Package type (container, generic, npm, maven, …). Omit on list to include every type

name: list_package_files
